fullDescription: Implements a PriceSmart-styled new membership view based on reference image 1777781281647-hz7g5mgy2b8.jpeg. The screen includes a compact top brand bar, a left step sidebar for membership data and payment, personal data, contact, address, and secondary memberships sections, plus footer actions for going home, saving changes, and continuing to payment.

Reusable membership-area header that renders the dark brand bar, logo, store selector, country selector, and language selector used by membership-focused views. It is intended for streamlined operational screens that need the simplified two-row header instead of the main ecommerce site navigation.

Reusable action tile for membership workflows with a circular icon, bold title, and active or inactive visual state. It can be used on landing screens to present options such as creating a membership, reviewing pending processes, or similar membership service actions.

shortDescription: Membership search and action landing screen.
fullDescription: Implements the membership landing view based on reference image 1777781280776-hz85g27aqjj.jpeg. The screen uses the reusable membership dashboard header and action tiles, then presents a search section for locating an existing member by name, phone, email, or membership ID before starting a new membership process.
